data.description:
OpenDGM is a modular Python framework designed to parse, analyse, and visualise both simulated and
clinical electrophysiological data. The software aims to lower the barrier to entry for researchers
and clinicians working in cardiac electrophysiology by providing reusable tools for data processing,
analysis, and visualisation.

Beyond data analysis, OpenDGM provides automated algorithms for detecting and characterising the
underlying mechanisms of arrhythmias. These tools facilitate the interpretation of clinical
recordings and the validation of computational models, helping users gain mechanistic insights into
complex electrophysiological phenomena, such as rotational activity, focal sources and phase
singularities.
